content.title: Citi says a ‘supermajors super-cycle’ is coming for U.S. airlines
content.summary: Investing.com -- Citi analyst John Godyn said in a note Thursday that the U.S. airline industry is heading into what they call a “Supermajors Super-Cycle,” arguing that 2026 will mark the start of an elongated mid-cycle in which the largest network carriers outperform the rest of the sector.
